meta.name: apex-profile
meta.description: Scope the tonone agent roster for this project — install a curated subset of agents instead of the full 100-agent bundle. Use when "cut down the agent list", "profile for this project", "too many agents", "only need the engineering core", or after apex-stats shows a roster that's mostly unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按项目需要选择安装 agents
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果面对上百个 agents 只想保留项目真正需要的几个
copy.tagline_en: Select only the agents your project truly needs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to cut down a huge agent roster to just what's needed for your project

howto.what: 将Claude变为工程领导Apex，可让你选择只安装项目真正需要的agent（从100个精简），而不是全部安装。它会询问你选择方式（预设、自定义、根据使用统计、恢复全量），然后修改配置文件以生效。
howto.when: 当你说“精简agent列表”、“按项目配置”、“agent太多”等，或apex-stats显示大部分agent未被使用时触发。

say.text: 帮我精简agent列表，只保留web-app预设的

howto.what_en: Transforms Claude into Apex, the engineering lead, to scope the installed agent roster to only those actually needed for the project, instead of all 100 agents. It asks for selection method (preset, custom, from stats, or full) and updates the configuration file.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say phrases like 'cut down agent list', 'profile for this project', 'too many agents', or after apex-stats shows mostly unused roster.

say_en.text: Please scope agent list to web-app preset only
Based on apex-stats, keep only used agents
